muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿تبت﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿يدا﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif because it is a dual; the nūn was dropped for the construct, and it is muḍāf.
﴿أبي لهب﴾: أبي is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the six nouns, and it is muḍāf; لهب is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra. The clause ﴿تبت﴾ is an imprecation (duʿāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position.
﴿وتب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تب is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to ﴿أبي لهب﴾. The clause ﴿تب﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تبت﴾ and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ما﴾: interrogative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أغنى﴾, i.e. "What thing did wealth avail him?" Or ﴿ما﴾ is a negative particle with no grammatical position.
﴿أغنى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa.
﴿عنه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أغنى﴾.
﴿ماله﴾: مال: the fāʿil (agent) of أغنى, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and it is muḍāf; the pronoun is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿ما أغنى عنه ماله﴾ is resumptive and has no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative by conjunction to ﴿ماله﴾; the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "and that which he earned". Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative, conjoined to ﴿ماله﴾, i.e. "and his earning". Or ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative, in the position of the accusative as a fronted direct object of ﴿كسب﴾, i.e. "and what thing did he earn?" Or ﴿ما﴾ is a negative particle with no grammatical position, i.e. "he did not earn".
﴿كسب﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". The clause ﴿كسب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; on the view that ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative or negative, the clause ﴿ما كسب﴾ is conjoined to the one before it and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿سيصلى﴾: the sīn is a particle of futurity; يصلى is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring to ﴿أبي لهب﴾.
﴿نارا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿ذات﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نارا﴾, accusative by the fatḥa, and it is muḍāf.
﴿لهب﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وامرأته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; امرأته is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يصلى﴾, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿حمالة﴾: accusative (manṣūb) for censure (ʿalā al-dhamm) by an omitted verb, i.e. "I censure the carrier of firewood"; and حمالة is muḍāf.
﴿الحطب﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿في جيدها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun; جيد is muḍāf, and the pronoun is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi; the quasi-clause (shibh al-jumla) is in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿حبل﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿من مسد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حبل﴾.
